author: CarbotAnimations
description:
We have survived Arrakis so far and it’s been a wild ride! Dare to take on the most
dangerous planet in the universe?
Dust off your still suit, power up your cutterray and hop on your sandbike!

Dune: Awakening for PC is now 50% off on Steam until October 8th .
You can also play it on PS5 and XBOX, available with Game Pass.
Cross-play coming post-launch!
Get the game here: https://tinyurl.com/GetDuneCarbotAnimations

Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival game with immersive adventure and RPG
gameplay. Explore, build, craft, and unravel a cinematic Dune story alone or with friends
as you rise from survival to greatness on the most legendary planet in the universe. Just
remember: the sandworm always comes.
#duneawakening #dune

Sponsored collaboration with Funcom, the developers of Dune: Awakening
